31910-memoirs-of-the-extraordinary-milit.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The church register records baptisms, not births, and a careful search has shown that the only entry answering to the above is a record of the _baptism_ of John, the child of Thomas and Lætitia Shipp, at a date twelve months earlier--March 16, 1784. The error probably explains the conflicting statements of the author's age which occur in the course of the story.

arxiv-2111-14083.title: A Grounded Well-being Conversational Agent with Multiple Interaction Modes: Preliminary Results
arxiv-2111-14083.creator: Xinxin Yan, Ndapa Nakashole
arxiv-2111-14083.description: Abstract Technologies for enhancing well-being, healthcare vigilance and monitoring are on the rise. However, despite patient interest, such technologies suffer from low adoption. One hypothesis for this limited adoption is loss of human interaction that is central to doctor-patient encounters.

arxiv-2302-08093.title: Improving On-Demand Single Photon Source Coherence and Indistinguishability Through a Time-Delayed Coherent Feedback
arxiv-2302-08093.creator: Gavin Crowder, Lora Ramunno, Stephen Hughes
arxiv-2302-08093.description: Abstract Single photon sources (SPSs) are an essential resource for many quantum information technologies. We demonstrate how the inclusion of time-delayed coherent feedback in a scalable waveguide system, can significantly improve the two key SPS figures of merit: coherence and indistinguishability.

arxiv-2304-03825.title: On the existence of ( r , g , χ ) (r,g,\chi) -cages Thanks: Research supported by PAPIIT-México IN108121, Intercambio Académico, UNAM. Grant: ”Buscando ciclos largos en gráficas bipartitas” and CONACyT-México 282280.
arxiv-2304-03825.creator: Gabriela Araujo-Pardo, Zhanar Berikkyzy, Linda Lesniak
arxiv-2304-03825.description: Abstract For integers r ≥ 2 r\geq 2 and g ≥ 3 g\geq 3 , an ( r , g ) (r,g) -graph is an r r -regular graph with girth g g , and an ( r , g ) (r,g) -cage is an ( r , g ) (r,g) -graph of minimum order.

arxiv-2305-03024.title: A Lattice Chiral Boson Theory in 1 + 1 1+1 d
arxiv-2305-03024.creator: Michael DeMarco, Ethan Lake, Xiao-Gang Wen
arxiv-2305-03024.description: Abstract Chiral field theories describe large classes of matter, from the edges of Quantum Hall systems to the electroweak sector of the Standard Model, but defining them on the lattice has been an ongoing challenge due to a no-go theorem precluding free local models, the potential of symmetry anomalies, and sign problems.

arxiv-2401-02846.title: Design spectra for 6-regular graphs with 12 vertices
arxiv-2401-02846.creator: A. D. Forbes, C. G. Rutherford
arxiv-2401-02846.description: Abstract . The design spectrum of a simple graph G G is the set of positive integers n n such that there exists an edgewise decomposition of the complete graph K n K_{n} into n ⁡ ( n − 1 ) / ( 2 ​ | E ⁡ ( G ) | ) n(n-1)/(2|E(G)|) copies of G G .

arxiv-2401-10377.title: Grain Size Effects on UV-MIR (0.2-14 μ \mu m) Spectra of Carbonaceous Chondrite Groups Journal: The Planetary Science Journal
arxiv-2401-10377.creator: David Cantillo, Vishnu Reddy, Adam Battle, Benjamin N. L. Sharkey, Neil C. Pearson, Tanner Campbell, Akash Satpathy, Mario De Florio, Roberto Furfaro, Juan Sanchez
arxiv-2401-10377.description: Abstract Carbonaceous chondrites are among the most important meteorite types and have played a vital role in deciphering the origin and evolution of our solar system. They have been linked to low-albedo C-type asteroids, but due to subdued absorption bands, definitive asteroid-meteorite linkages remain elusive.

arxiv-2404-02164.title: Exploring Correlation Patterns in the Ethereum Validator Network
arxiv-2404-02164.creator: Simon Brown, Leonardo Bautista-Gomez
arxiv-2404-02164.description: Abstract There have been several studies into measuring the level of decentralization in Ethereum through applying various indices to indicate the relative dominance of entities in different domains in the ecosystem. However, these indices do not capture any correlation between those different entities, that could potentially make them the subject of external coercion, or covert collusion.

arxiv-2408-04041.title: A Deixis-Centered Approach for Documenting Remote Synchronous Communication around Data Visualizations
arxiv-2408-04041.creator: Chang Han and Katherine E. Isaacs
arxiv-2408-04041.description: Abstract Referential gestures, or as termed in linguistics, deixis , are an essential part of communication around data visualizations. Despite their importance, such gestures are often overlooked when documenting data analysis meetings. Transcripts, for instance, fail to capture gestures, and video recordings may not adequately capture or emphasize them.

arxiv-2408-05749.title: Efficient and Versatile Robust Fine-Tuning of Zero-shot Models
arxiv-2408-05749.creator: Sungyeon Kim Boseung Jeong Donghyun Kim Suha Kwak
arxiv-2408-05749.description: Abstract Large-scale image-text pre-trained models enable zero-shot classification and provide consistent accuracy across various data distributions. Nonetheless, optimizing these models in downstream tasks typically requires fine-tuning, which reduces generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) data and demands extensive computational resources. We introduce Robust Adapter (R-Adapter), a novel method for fine-tuning zero-shot models to downstream tasks while simultaneously addressing both these issues.

arxiv-2410-22778.title: Zero-energy Quantum Many-Body Scar under Emergent Chiral Symmetry and Pseudo Hilbert Space Fragmentation
arxiv-2410-22778.creator: Li Zhang, Yongguan Ke, Chaohong Lee
arxiv-2410-22778.description: Abstract Hilbert space fragmentation (HSF) is a mechanism for generating quantum many-body scar (QMBS), which provides a route to weakly break ergodicity. Many scarred systems possess an exponentially large number of zero-energy states due to the chiral symmetry induced bipartition of the Hilbert space.

arxiv-2501-10606.title: Differentiable Adversarial Attacks for Marked Temporal Point Processes
arxiv-2501-10606.creator: Pritish Chakraborty, Vinayak Gupta, Rahul R, Srikanta J. Bedathur, Abir De
arxiv-2501-10606.description: Abstract Marked temporal point processes (MTPPs) have been shown to be extremely effective in modeling continuous time event sequences (CTESs). In this work, we present adversarial attacks designed specifically for MTPP models. A key criterion for a good adversarial attack is its imperceptibility.

arxiv-2505-01244.title: A CFL-type Condition and Theoretical Insights for Discrete-Time Sparse Full-Order Model Inference
arxiv-2505-01244.creator: Leonidas Gkimisis, Süleyman Yıldız, Peter Benner, Thomas Richter
arxiv-2505-01244.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the data-driven inference of a discrete-time dynamical system via a sparse Full-Order Model (sFOM). We first formulate the involved Least Squares (LS) problem and discuss the need for regularization, indicating a connection between the typically employed l 2 l_{2} regularization and the stability of the inferred discrete-time sFOM.

pmc-10506321.title: How can we reduce the ischemic time for forearm replantation? Tips to simplify the bone fixation
pmc-10506321.creator: Dong Hee Kim, Hyo Seok Jang, Sang Ho Kwak, Sung Yoon Jung, Jongmin Jeon, Hak Sang Kim, Sang Hyun Lee
pmc-10506321.description: PurposeIschemic time is a key factor in satisfactory functional results after forearm replantation. In this study, we provide a detailed description of our surgical technique, the temporary screw plate fixation technique, which aims to reduce ischemic time.MethodsFrom June 2007 to June 2017, we performed a retrospective study of 20 patients who underwent forearm replantation.

pmc-10656075.title: Major shifts in biogeographic regions of freshwater fishes as evidence of the Anthropocene epoch
pmc-10656075.creator: Boris Leroy, Céline Bellard, Murilo S. Dias, Bernard Hugueny, Céline Jézéquel, Fabien Leprieur, Thierry Oberdorff, Marine Robuchon, Pablo A. Tedesco
pmc-10656075.description: Animals and plants worldwide are structured in global biogeographic regions, which were shaped by major geologic forces during Earth history. Recently, humans have changed the course of events by multiplying global pathways of introduction for nonindigenous species and propagating local species extirpations.

pmc-10671267.title: Evolution of the Critically Endangered Green Sawfish Pristis zijsron (Rhinopristiformes, Pristidae), Inferred from the Whole Mitochondrial Genome
pmc-10671267.creator: Chen Wang, Peiyuan Ye, Richard Pillans, Xiao Chen, Junjie Wang, Pierre Feutry, Manuel Vera Rodríguez
pmc-10671267.description: The green sawfish Pristis zijsron (Bleeker, 1851), a species of sawfish in the family Pristidae (Rhinopristiformes), mainly inhabits the Indo-West Pacific region. In this study, the complete mitochondrial genome of the critically endangered green sawfish is first described. The length of the genome is 16,804 bp, with a nucleotide composition of 32.0% A, 24.8% C, 13.1% G, and 30.0% T.

pmc-10989777.title: Dual functions: A coumarin–chalcone conjugate inhibits cyclic‐di‐GMP and quorum‐sensing signaling to reduce biofilm formation and virulence of pathogens
pmc-10989777.creator: Yu Zhang, Pramod Bhasme, Dinesh S Reddy, Dejian Liu, Zhaoxiao Yu, Tianhu Zhao, Yaqian Zheng, Amit Kumar, Haiying Yu, Luyan Z Ma
pmc-10989777.description: Antibiotic resistance or tolerance of pathogens is one of the most serious global public health threats. Bacteria in biofilms show extreme tolerance to almost all antibiotic classes. Thus, use of antibiofilm drugs without bacterial‐killing effects is one of the strategies to combat antibiotic tolerance.

pmc-11418856.title: Adaptation of the RESPECT framework to prevent violence against women, Indonesia
pmc-11418856.creator: Alegra Wolter, Yuniyanti Chuzaifah, Aflina Mustafainah, Nunik Nurjanah, Ali A Ramly, Eni Widiyanti, Norcahyo B Waskito, Yuni Asriyanti, Cresti E Fitriana, Sri Wahyuni, Risya Kori, Dirna Mayasari, Agusmia P Haerani, Yasmin Purba, Inga Williams
pmc-11418856.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ProblemViolence against women is a global health problem. Effectively preventing such violence requires locally adapted strategies.ApproachThe World Health Organization in Indonesia, in collaboration with United Nations (UN) Population Fund, UN Women, United Nations Children’s Fund, United Nations Development Programme and Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS, launched capacity-building initiatives to introduce RESPECT as an evidence-based framework to address violence against women. The initiatives included stakeholder engagement, module development, sensitization training, a workshop and evaluation sessions.

pmc-12542235.title: Identification of novel dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (DHODH) inhibitors for cancer: computational drug repurposing strategy
pmc-12542235.creator: Rahamathtunnisa Rajamohamed, Shanthi Veerappapillai
pmc-12542235.description: BackgroundDihydroorotate dehydrogenase (DHODH) is a crucial enzyme in de novo pyrimidine production, initially sought since its disruption is frequently observed in malignancies. DHODH inhibitors have been demonstrated in multiple trials to effectively destroy tumour cells. For instance, leflunomide, teriflunomide and brequinar are currently in practice for DHODH based therapeutics.

pmc-12646713.title: Validation of the Korean Version of the Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale-Revised in Korean Adolescents
pmc-12646713.creator: Ji-Min Kim, Kyeong-Sook Choi, Ji Ae Nam, Hyun Woo Han, Je-Chun Yu
pmc-12646713.description: Objective The Korean version of the Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale-Revised (K-CESD-R) is widely used in community epidemiology studies to screen depressive symptoms, given its proven reliability in diverse populations. However, it has not yet been validated in Korean adolescents. Therefore, this study validated and standardized the K-CESD-R for use in Korean adolescents.

pmc-13347671.title: Propagation Process of Noncaking Coal Dust Explosion Impact Airflow and Generation Characteristics of CO and CO2 in Vertical Space
pmc-13347671.creator: Tianqi Liu, Fengshuo Leng

pmc-13366638.title: Influence of adrenomedullin on the enzymatic activity of dipeptidyl peptidase 3 in vitro
pmc-13366638.creator: Ruqayyah Nissen, Amin Yourdkhani, Marie-Louise Hollerbach, Katja Seewald, Karine Santos, Joachim Struck, Andreas Bergmann
pmc-13366638.description: Circulating Dipeptidyl Peptidase 3 (DPP3) hydrolyses dipeptides from the amino terminus of its substrates and excess levels represent a target for the treatment of cardiogenic shock. Known substrates include Angiotensin II (Ang II), but there might be more. Adrenomedullin (ADM) is a 52-mer peptide regulating vascular tone and integrity, which also is a therapeutic target for the treatment of shock.

pmc-13547707.title: Multifunctional Quantum Sensing Using Single Spins in a van der Waals Crystal
pmc-13547707.creator: James Liddle‐Wesolowski, Konosuke Shimazaki, Jiyun Kim, Benjamin Whitefield, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Mehran Kianinia, Igor Aharonovich
pmc-13547707.description: Nanoscale thermometry and magnetometry are in high demand across a wide range of scientific and technological applications. In this context, optically addressable spins in solids have emerged at the forefront of on‐chip quantum sensing. However, simultaneous quantum sensing of multiple parameters (e.g., temperature and magnetic field) using the same spin sensor remains challenging due to cross‐sensitivity to multiple physical quantities.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2009cc.title: 7 U.S.C. § 2009cc — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t7-s2009cc.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2009cc.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 50 (Agricultural Credit); Subchapter VIII (Rural Business Investment Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this subchapter: (1) Articles The term “articles” means articles of incorporation for an incorporated body or the functional equivalent or other similar documents specified by the Secretary for other business entities. (2) Developmental capital The term “developmental capital” means capital.
